description: This Java class implements the QueueDao interface for managing Queue entities in a SQL database, providing methods for retrieving queues by various criteria, including tenant ID, name, topic, and pagination.

classes.name: JpaQueueDao
classes.description: Implementation of QueueDao and TenantEntityDao for Queue entities, providing database access methods.

methods.name: getEntityClass
methods.description: Returns the class type of the QueueEntity.

methods.name: getRepository
methods.description: Provides the JpaRepository instance for QueueEntity.

methods.name: findQueueByTenantIdAndTopic
methods.description: Finds a Queue by tenant ID and topic.

methods.name: findQueueByTenantIdAndName
methods.description: Finds a Queue by tenant ID and name.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves all queues associated with a tenant ID.

methods.name: findAllMainQueues
methods.description: Retrieves all queues with the main queue name.

methods.name: findQueuesByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves queues for a tenant with pagination and search.

methods.name: findAllByTenantId
methods.description: Alias for findQueuesByTenantId, retrieves queues for a tenant with pagination.

methods.name: getEntityType
methods.description: Returns the entity type, which is QUEUE.
